work.title: Musik til Chr. K.F. Molbechs skuespil "Ambrosius"
Music for Chr. K.F. Molbech's play "Ambrosius"

history.p: Chr. K.F. Molbech was not only a playwright but also censor at The Royal Theatre, which caused a lot of complications, delaying the first performance considerably. The critics praised the actors and Hartmann's music, and a veritable "Ambrosius Fever" spread over the country. Between May 1877 and May 1885 it was performed seventy-three times.

annot.p: Separate print from a collection containing songs by A. Bazzani, N. C. Bochsa, Niels W. Gade, Peter Heise, Fr. Kuhlau, Axel Liebmann, Henrik Rung and C.E.F. Weyse. This edition also includes as no. 3 the Danish Folk Song "Jeg lagde mit Hoved til Elverhøj" with German text: "Ich legt' auf den Elfenhügel mein Haupt".
